fact: The Isoko procedure page for the national identity card lists as its main texts only ministerial ordinances of 1978 and 1986 on the card (no identity law) and says further texts remain to be adopted to institute the Fichier National d'Identification; the page prints no date, so its published date 2026 is used.
system: Fichier National d'Identification / Carte Nationale d'Identité
